name: All-Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official page states that the plate is formed by an automatic production line and the plate bundles are welded by a dedicated program-controlled automatic welding machine. All plate bundles are welded inside the shell, and the cover plate can be opened for mechanical cleaning. The product is positioned as a compact and efficient alternative to shell-and-tube heat exchangers for central heating, metallurgy, petrochemical, chemical, electric power, medicine, food, and related service.
advantage: Plate bundles are fully welded inside the shell.
Cover plate can be opened for mechanical cleaning.
Flow channel structure is intended to prevent medium leakage and fluid crossover.
Combines compact structure and high heat transfer efficiency with higher pressure and temperature resistance.

seo_data.meta_description: Fully welded plate exchanger installed inside a shell for high-pressure and high-temperature duty.
